header.question: As of 25 January 2027, how exposed are Midgard and Tolan to the end of the Orvan corridor agreement? Give a low and high range for wheat and maize imports.
header.ruling_mode: run 1: MODEL_ON_OPEN_CLAIMS; run 2: RULES_ONLY; narrative MODEL

executive_summary.text: As of 2027-01-25, the exposure to Orvan grain corridor collapse is: Midgard Wheat: net value shortfall of 54.8% to 57.7%; Midgard Maize: net value shortfall of 38.5% to 38.5%; Tolan Wheat: net value shortfall of 50.8% to 55.8%; Tolan Maize: insufficient evidence (NO_DOCUMENTED_FLOW), no number given…

event_verification.text: Orvan grain corridor collapse is verified: current top-tier case-event document asserts the event.

established.text: A news report states: "Midgard's flour millers are booking wheat from Vanir and asking for more rail capacity from Ravik after Orvan's sea loadings fell in September." [ORV-0006, P1, 2026-10-08 08:45]
Direct-route value for Midgard Wheat imports changed by -60.3% and volume by -65.2% against the same months one year earlier (4 paired months). [ORV-0009, P4, 2027-01-19 09:20]
Direct-route value for Tolan Wheat imports changed by -60.3% and volume by -64.8% against the same months one year earlier (4 paired months). [ORV-0046, P4, 2027-01-20 10:05]
A news report states: "Preliminary customs figures show Midgard's wheat and maize arrivals from Orvan well below the levels of a year earlier in December." [ORV-0022, P1, 2027-01-12 07:55]
Direct-route value for Midgard Maize imports changed by -38.5% and volume by -42.5% against the same months one year earlier (4 paired months). [ORV-0030, P4, 2027-01-21 09:35]
Loki estimates a net value shortfall of 54.8% to 57.7% for Midgard Wheat imports, crediting documented substitute growth in full. [ORV-0009, P4, 2027-01-19 09:20] [ORV-0027, P5, 2027-01-22 09:05]
Loki estimates a net value shortfall of 50.8% to 55.8% for Tolan Wheat imports, crediting documented substitute growth in full. [ORV-0046, P4, 2027-01-20 10:05] [ORV-0044, P5, 2027-01-22 10:50]
A trade note states: "December was the weakest month of the half-year, and rail loadings through Ravik were still rising." [ORV-0009, P14, 2027-01-19 09:20]
Substitute routes into Midgard for Wheat changed by 15.6% in value over the same paired months, offsetting part of the direct-route loss. [ORV-0027, P5, 2027-01-22 09:05]
Substitute routes into Tolan for Wheat changed by 18.1% in value over the same paired months, offsetting part of the direct-route loss. [ORV-0044, P5, 2027-01-22 10:50]

Thor narrows its Midgard Wheat estimate to 57.6% to 57.7% (half of the documented substitute growth credited) after challenge-loki-001. [ORV-0009, P4, 2027-01-19 09:20] [ORV-0027, P5, 2027-01-22 09:05]
Thor narrows its Tolan Wheat estimate to 55.6% to 55.8% (half of the documented substitute growth credited) after challenge-loki-002. [ORV-0046, P4, 2027-01-20 10:05] [ORV-0044, P5, 2027-01-22 10:50]
Thor estimates a net value shortfall of 38.5% to 38.5% for Midgard Maize imports, crediting at most half of the documented substitute growth. [ORV-0030, P4, 2027-01-21 09:35]

No trade row from Orvan into Tolan for Maize is documented in the case scope; the search for this cell (cited results, background documents as context only) found none, so no range is given. [ORV-0046, P1, 2027-01-20 10:05] [ORV-0044, P1, 2027-01-22 10:50] [ORV-0042, P4, 2026-11-25 13:05]
Loki estimates a net value shortfall of 38.5% to 38.5% for Midgard Maize imports, crediting documented substitute growth in full. [ORV-0030, P4, 2027-01-21 09:35]

conceded.text: A company statement states: "Anchor Marine says Tolan Harbour is handling more wheat cargoes from Vanir as Tolan buyers replace some Orvan supply." Conceded by Loki after a INTERESTED_PARTY challenge. [ORV-0042, P1, 2026-11-25 13:05] Reason given: No independent top-tier evidence answers INTERESTED_…
